metadata.estimand: office winner if voting occurred at information cutoff, after jurisdiction-specific counting

interpretation: Paired draws, same race polls; first-stage leaders before runoff or ranked-choice counting. Baseline includes the fitted governor local-lean model; its separate pre-poll before/after impact is recorded under governor_local_lean.

governor_local_lean.estimand: state governor D-minus-R margin relative to the drawn national House margin

uncertainty_calibration.source: expanding-cycle out-of-fold residuals from 2020-2024; terminal results proxy held-today outcomes

governor_local_lean.legacy_governor_open_seat_shift: disabled; open-seat status is not separately applied

map.source: The Downballot, 2024 presidential votes by 2024 and 2026 House boundaries

input_metadata.approval_source: Morning Consult, October-December 2025 three-month registered-voter rollup
input_metadata.historical_approval_source: Singer State Executive Approval Dataset v1, UNC Dataverse doi:10.15139/S3/QHHQEF
